findings.text: ROBUSTNESS (W7-adjacent, SYSTEMIC across all 7 packs, not aider-specific): no automated check asserts the COMMITTED git-index mode of the wrapper hooks/pre-push. The selftest checks working-tree executability (os.access X_OK, which can diverge from the index), and the mode-aware drift-check covers only ENGINE_GLOBS (the wrapper hook is a per-pack authored file, not engine). At dfa5934 the committed mode is correct (100755), so this is NOT a defect - but given W7's exact lesson (git silently skips a non-executable committed hook, fail-open), a future edit committing the wrapper hook 644 while the local tree is 755 would pass selftest. Scheduled for W9 (WARP-0809, cross-pack conformance) as its natural home.
